current.messageZh: 火災危險警告為紅色，表示火災危險性極高。
current.messageEn: The Fire Danger Warning is Red and the fire risk is extreme.

forecast.generalSituationZh: 一股達強風程度的東北季候風會在明日繼續為華南帶來晴朗及乾燥的天氣，內陸地區日夜溫差頗大。預料季候風會在下週初逐漸緩和，同時高空反氣旋會為華南帶來大致良好的天氣。受一股偏東氣流影響，下週中後期廣東沿岸日間相當溫暖，天氣漸轉潮濕。
forecast.generalSituationEn: A strong northeast monsoon will continue to bring fine and dry weather to southern China tomorrow. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large over inland areas. The monsoon is expected to moderate gradually early next week. Meanwhile, an anticyclone aloft will bring mainly fine weather to southern China. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be rather warm during the day and the weather will become humid over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week.
